## Multi-Species Trend Over Time
The data has dynamically parsed detection counts for both `Gen_alg` and `Ran_ado` datasets using native indexing logic directly to the Excel dataset.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import plotly.express as px

df = pd.read_csv('results/Gen_alg_summary.csv')
df['Collection_Date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Collection_Date'])

# Create an interactive responsive line timeline grouping by date and species
df_grouped = df.groupby(['Collection_Date', 'Species'])['Detections'].agg(['mean', 'std']).reset_index()
df_grouped['upper'] = df_grouped['mean'] + df_grouped['std'].fillna(0)
df_grouped['lower'] = (df_grouped['mean'] - df_grouped['std'].fillna(0)).clip(lower=0)

fig = go.Figure()

colors = {
    'Gen_alg': ('blue', 'rgba(0,100,255,0.2)'),
    'Ran_ado': ('#e6005c', 'rgba(230,0,92,0.2)')
}

for sp in df_grouped['Species'].unique():
    sp_df = df_grouped[df_grouped['Species'] == sp]
    line_col, fill_col = colors.get(sp, ('green', 'rgba(0,255,0,0.2)'))
    
    # Add lower and upper bound with a filled polynomial polygon
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=sp_df['Collection_Date'].tolist() + sp_df['Collection_Date'].tolist()[::-1],
        y=sp_df['upper'].tolist() + sp_df['lower'].tolist()[::-1],
        fill='toself',
        fillcolor=fill_col,
        line=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0)'),
        hoverinfo="skip",
        showlegend=False
    ))
    
    # Add mean line
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=sp_df['Collection_Date'],
        y=sp_df['mean'],
        mode='lines+markers',
        name=f'{sp} Average',
        line=dict(color=line_col)
    ))

fig.update_layout(
    title='Comparative Pollen Detections Over Collection Dates',
    xaxis_title='Date of Collection',
    yaxis_title='Average Pollen Count',
    margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=40, b=20), autosize=True
)
fig.show()
```

## Specimen Variance Distribution

```{python}
import plotly.express as px

fig2 = px.box(df, x='Collection_Date', y='Detections', color='Species', points="all",
              color_discrete_map={'Gen_alg': 'blue', 'Ran_ado': '#e6005c'},
              title='Pollen Detections Variance Per Collection Date (Species Indexed)',
              hover_data=['kod kytky + datum', 'Original_File'])
fig2.update_layout(xaxis_title='Date of Collection', yaxis_title='Pollen Count',
                   margin=dict(l=20, r=20, t=40, b=20), autosize=True)
fig2.show()
```

## Raw Tabular Metrics

```{python}
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# Select a subset of highly relevant columns for presentation
df_display = df[['kod kytky + datum', 'Species', 'Collection_Date', 'Detections', 'barvivo [μl]', 'na sklíčko [μ]']].copy()
df_display['Collection_Date'] = df_display['Collection_Date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
df_display.rename(columns={'kod kytky + datum': 'Excel Sample Code'}, inplace=True)

display(HTML(df_display.to_html(classes='table table-striped table-hover', index=False)))
```
